candidates.title: RECOIL BALANCE
candidates.description: Tap fires at the reticle's current position, but each shot kicks the reticle away by an amount that compounds if you fire again before it settles.

candidates.title: FOCUS SIPHON
candidates.description: Tap an enemy to drain its fire rate from a shared focus meter that depletes with each tap and regenerates slowly; fully draining one enemy removes it, spreading taps only slows several.

candidates.title: SPLIT AIM
candidates.description: Drag from the reticle out to a second point to fork one shot into two weaker halves, each traveling toward one of the two points instead of a single full-power shot.

candidates.title: LANE CURRENT
candidates.description: Drag switches which of three lanes a continuously auto-firing turret occupies, trading time spent clearing one lane's queue against jumping early to a lane about to overflow.

candidates.title: GRAVITY DROP
candidates.description: Drag places a short-lived gravity well that pulls nearby targets toward its center to merge into a higher-value cluster, at the cost of slowing their approach to the collection line.

candidates.title: PAIR LINK
candidates.description: Tap two targets in sequence to draw a connecting beam that destroys both after a completion time proportional to their distance, during which either can move out of range and cancel it.

candidates.title: ECHO MIRROR
candidates.description: Tap fires immediately and schedules a second shot at the same screen coordinate after a fixed delay, rewarding aiming ahead of a moving target's predicted future position rather than its current one.

candidates.title: OVERDRAW METER
candidates.description: Tap fires normally but also fills a shared board-wide meter; once it tops out, every visible target simultaneously surges in speed for a few seconds.

candidates.title: WEIGHT SHIFT
candidates.description: Hold anywhere tilts a suspended platform toward that side, rolling loose targets toward score chutes on either edge; releasing snaps the platform back level.

candidates.title: RICOCHET COUNT
candidates.description: Tap fires a shot that bounces off screen edges a number of times equal to a counter that grows with consecutive hits and resets on a miss, with farther targets scoring more but needing more surviving bounces.

candidates.title: PATIENCE GATE
candidates.description: Hold on a target keeps a gate open that queues its incoming reinforcements harmlessly behind it; releasing early collapses the gate and every queued reinforcement arrives at once.

reason: RECOIL BALANCE has the highest total (25 vs 24 and 22), ties for the top C1 and C6 scores, and leads outright on C3 and C7 — its firing decision is the only one where the player's own actions reshape the control space for the next action, which no existing work does and which keeps rewarding paced-vs-burst judgment as the player improves.
